explication: Metals is a Scala language server: an editor communicates over LSP, workspace requests are routed to project services, and those services provide Scala-aware language features alongside build-server integration. The repository also exposes an MCP mode for tool-driven queries. The graph highlights those user-facing domains and compiler/indexing internals. Evidence is limited to the README, listed source references, and excerpts; unsampled implementations are represented only where the index or documentation supports them.
